mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audio_tasks (user_id, source_text, speed, noise_type, noise_factor, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sourceText}, #{speed}, #{noiseType}, #{noiseFactor},#{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 AND update_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND update_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 END) AS todaySuccessCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = -1 AND update_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND update_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 END) AS todayFailedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS processingCount FROM audio_tasks
mapper.update: UPDATE audio_tasks SET status = #{cancelledStatus}, error_msg = '任务已取消', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1) AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audio_tasks WHERE status IN (0, 1) AND update_time < #{before} LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE audio_tasks SET status = 0, retry_time = retry_time + 1, result_url = NULL, audio_size = NULL, error_msg = NULL, completed_date = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1) AND retry_time < 3 AND update_time < #{before}
UPDATE audio_tasks SET status = -1, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1) AND retry_time >= 3 AND update_time < #{before}
